text:
sabrina: FYI ACME Retail renewal in 28d and onboarding metrics look off — 45% of seats not activating features. Think we should spin a micro save this week? :warning:
maya: yes. seeing drop in 'integrations' step in the funnel. they signed for Dedicated so SLA is a conversation too.
liam: agree. propose 2-step: 1) enablement deep-dive (60m) + checklist, 2) downgrade-safe offer if still stuck at renewal. low-friction for CS.
sabrina: love that. can we capture why they're stuck quickly? want feedback to feed product and prevent other accounts.
maya: quick survey (3 q's) + session recording opt-in. suggested questions:
```
1) Which step blocked you most?
2) Which feature do you need most to be successful?
3) What would make you keep the current plan?
```
liam: add an ask-for-timing q so we can prioritize time zones. also propose sending a pre-read with 3 toggles we can flip in-session (permissions, rate limits, sample data).
sabrina: @maya can you run the enablement session Thurs? I'll draft the downgrade-swap offer (1 month at 50% + 1 enablement) as fallback.
maya: I can do Thurs 11am PT. putting a calendar invite now.
csm_bot: Reminder created: "Enablement: ACME Retail" Thu 11:00 PT — owner: maya — link: https://calendar.internal/enablement/5467890123
liam: thank you. I'll build the quick-save checklist and the short playbook snippet to paste into the account record. Keep it 5 bullets for reps.
sabrina: also let's capture the session notes in Gainsight and attach the 3-question survey results. I'll add a template for the feedback notes.
maya: sending survey immediately after session via email + Slack DM.
liam: on the downgrade offer, suggest we include an automatic timed rollback to the original tier after 30 days so they don't feel stuck.
sabrina: perfect. owner assignments: maya = enablement session + survey send; liam = checklist + playbook snippet; sabrina = downgrade offer draft + product feedback handoff. i'll update the account tag to "at-risk-onboard".
maya: done. calendar + preliminary pre-read sent.
liam: draft playbook snippet in #cs-templates in 15.
sabrina: thanks team. if the session goes well we'll push a small expansion play instead of the downgrade. keep notes tight. :white_check_mark:
